player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop of guessing words that are similar to the previous ones, but with a single letter changed. This led to a situation where I was guessing words that were not significantly different from the previous ones, and I failed to make a breakthrough. What's worse, I repeated the same mistake of guessing words that contained red letters (letters that are not in the word) multiple times. Next time, I will try to think more broadly and make a more significant change in my guess. I will also make sure to avoid guessing words that contain red letters. For example, I will look for words that contain the yellow letters (letters that are in the word but in the wrong position) and try to use them in a more creative way. I will also pay closer attention to the clue and try to incorporate more of its information into my guess.
